# brig sandbox snapshot prune

Delete the snapshots of deleted sandboxes and old snapshots

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox snapshot prune [VM] [--keep N] [--older-than AGE] [--dry-run] [-w W]
```

## Description

Delete the snapshots of sandboxes that are gone, and of each other sandbox
all but the newest --keep, one by default. --older-than also deletes the
snapshots taken longer ago than AGE, such as 30d, whatever --keep says. -w
prunes only that workspace's snapshots.

prune prints each snapshot it deletes and the space that frees. --dry-run
prints what it would delete and deletes nothing.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox snapshot prune dev --dry-run
brig sandbox snapshot prune dev --keep 3 --older-than 30d
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | print what would be deleted, and delete nothing |
| `--keep int` | keep this many of the newest snapshots of each sandbox (default `1`) |
| `--older-than string` | also delete snapshots older than this, e.g. 30d |
| `-w, --workspace string` | prune only the snapshots of this workspace |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
